MRT.note: The abstract states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
The abstract names no AI system in use in administration.
The abstract names no AI tool in a sector's public system.
The abstract names no AI model, dataset or computing built in the country.

facts.fact: A paper published 2025-10-29 by authors including Dah Abdellahi Bellahi of the Universite de Nouakchott analyses Mauritania's e-government and digital transformation through the EGDI, E-Participation, NRI and IDI indices.
